extracted.name: Simple Roasted Butternut Squash
extracted.description: This simple roasted butternut squash recipe with only 4 ingredients makes a delicious side that caramelizes and sweetens as it roasts in the oven.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Peel butternut squash with a vegetable peeler. Halve lengthwise; scoop out and discard seeds.
Combine butternut squash cubes, oil, and garlic in a large bowl; toss to coat. Season with salt and pepper.
Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven until squash is golden and tender when pierced with a fork, 25 to 35 minutes.
